# Coohom

> > Coohom is an AI-powered 2D/3D floor and room planner for free home design, offering instant visualization, CAD conversion, and real-time rendering across residential and commercial spaces.

Coohom provides a comprehensive suite of design tools for homeowners, interior designers, and professionals. The platform features AI-assisted layout generation, multi-format file support (PDF, JPG, DWG), and high-fidelity 3D rendering capabilities for planning homes, kitchens, bathrooms, offices, and specialized rooms.
